# Mishpacha Tours, kosher holidays in the Alps and Lyon

> Strictly kosher holidays in the Alps and Lyon, shomer shabbat. A chalet in Les Deux Alpes (seven bedrooms and a baby room, 15 to 16 guests, two minutes from the slopes) with a private kosher chef and daily cleaning; kosher meals, Shabbat, holidays and a minyan with a Sefer Torah arranged in the ski resorts (Les Deux Alpes, Courchevel, Val Thorens, Megeve, Alpe d'Huez, Val d'Isere, Les Arcs, La Plagne, Chamonix, Annecy, Grenoble); private transfers from Lyon or Geneva; every request answered with a day-by-day programme, price at the end. Requests by WhatsApp +33 6 52 09 23 01 (answered in English, Hebrew, French or Spanish) or contact@mishpachatours.com.

Jewish Lyon: private, strictly kosher guided tours led by a Jewish, observant, state-licensed guide-conferencier, including the only tour that goes inside the Grande Synagogue of Lyon (quai Tilsitt, 1864) by a special authorisation that Mishpacha Tours holds. Five tours (Jewish Lyon 2.5 h, Memory CHRD, Memory Montluc and Neveh Shalom, Stopover 3 h between the airport and the Alps, Izieu day trip), guided in English, French or Spanish, priced per group (from 290 EUR for 1 to 4 people), free cancellation up to 24 hours before, never on Shabbat or Jewish holidays, security escort on request. The site also documents the kosher restaurants, synagogues, Chabad houses, mikvaot and Shabbat logistics of Lyon and Villeurbanne. Facts are sourced and dated on each page; verify hours and prices before travelling.

## Alps: kosher holidays, chalet, resorts

- [Kosher Alps: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/alps/): Strictly kosher in the Alps: a private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, a minyan and a Sefer Torah. One request, one quote.
- [Flights to Lyon and the road to the ski resorts](https://mishpachatours.com/flights-to-lyon/): Flights to Lyon-Saint-Exupéry, the airport for Val Thorens, Courchevel and Alpe d'Huez: direct flights from Tel Aviv, drive times and kosher shopping.
- [Kosher Alpe d'Huez: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-alpe-dhuez/): Kosher Alpe d'Huez at 1,860 m, with a long kosher summer history: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, minyan and Sefer Torah.
- [Kosher Annecy and La Clusaz: Chef, Shabbat](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-annecy/): Kosher Annecy: the lake in summer, La Clusaz and the Aravis in winter. Private chef, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays and a minyan. One written quote.
- [Kosher Chalet in Courchevel, Pools and Chef](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-chalet-courchevel/): A kosher chalet in the heart of Courchevel: 5 en-suite bedrooms, heated pools and hammam, a private chef, Shabbat and a minyan. One written quote.
- [Kosher Chalet in Les Deux Alpes, 16 Beds](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-chalet-les-deux-alpes/): A 300 m² kosher chalet in Les Deux Alpes: 6 bedrooms, 16 beds, 2 minutes from the slopes. Private chef, Shabbat and holidays, everything organised. One quote.
- [Kosher Chalets in the Alps: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-chalets/): Two kosher chalets in the Alps, in Les Deux Alpes and in Courchevel: a private chef, Shabbat and a minyan in the chalet. One request, one written quote.
- [Kosher Chamonix: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-chamonix/): Kosher Chamonix under Mont Blanc, in winter and summer: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One quote.
- [Kosher Courchevel: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-courchevel/): Kosher Courchevel 1850 and the villages of Les 3 Vallées: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays and a minyan. One request, one quote.
- [Kosher Grenoble: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-grenoble/): Kosher Grenoble, your base for the Isère resorts: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One written quote.
- [Kosher La Plagne: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-la-plagne/): Kosher La Plagne across its 11 villages: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One written quote.
- [Kosher Les Arcs: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-les-arcs/): Kosher Les Arcs, four villages from 1,600 to 2,000 m linked to La Plagne: chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, minyan and Sefer Torah. One quote.
- [Kosher Les Deux Alpes: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-les-deux-alpes/): Kosher Les Deux Alpes, a glacier resort at 1,650 m with its own kosher summer season: private chef, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays and minyan. One quote.
- [Kosher Megève: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-megeve/): Kosher Megève and its 445 km of linked pistes: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One written quote.
- [Private Kosher Chef in the Alps](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-services-french-alps/): Hire a private kosher chef for your chalet in the Alps: meals for the whole group, Shabbat and holiday tables, and a minyan and Sefer Torah on request.
- [Kosher Ski Holidays in the Alps](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-ski-holidays-french-alps/): Kosher ski in the Alps: Chabad minyanim in Courchevel and Megève, kosher programs by resort, Shabbat on the mountain, and Lyon as your first stop.
- [Kosher Vacation in the Alps](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-vacation-french-alps/): A kosher vacation in the Alps: your chalet or apartment, our chef, delivered meals, Shabbat and a minyan. Ski in winter, lakes in summer. One quote.
- [Kosher Val d'Isère: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-val-disere/): Kosher Val d'Isère at 1,850 m, with shared slopes with Tignes up to 3,456 m: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, minyan. One quote.
- [Kosher Val Thorens: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-val-thorens/): Kosher Val Thorens at 2,300 m, the highest resort in Europe: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays and minyan. One written quote.
- [Lyon, gateway to the Alps for Jewish travellers](https://mishpachatours.com/lyon-gateway-to-the-alps-kosher/): Drive times from Lyon to 13 resorts, airport shuttles, where to buy kosher food before you go up, and a three-hour Jewish Lyon stopover on the way.
- [Summer in the Alps for Jewish Families](https://mishpachatours.com/summer-in-the-alps-jewish-families/): Kosher summer in the French Alps: synagogues, mikveh and meals in Aix-les-Bains, Annecy and Grenoble, and Lyon as your base.

## Jewish Lyon tours

- [Private Jewish Tours of Lyon, Strictly Kosher](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-lyon-tours/): Five private Jewish tours of Lyon, including inside the Grande Synagogue, with a Jewish, observant, licensed guide. Strictly kosher, priced per group.
- [Izieu, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/izieu/): A full day at the Maison d'Izieu, one hour from Lyon. Private, strictly kosher, from 990 € quote on request. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Jewish Tour of Lyon Inside the Grande Synagogue](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/jewish-lyon/): A private walk through the Jewish story of Lyon, inside the Grande Synagogue. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Memory: the CHRD, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/memory-chrd/): A private visit of the Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Memory: Montluc and Neveh Shalom](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/memory-montluc-neveh-shalom/): The Montluc memorial, then the second synagogue we take you inside. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Stopover, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/stopover/): Three hours in Jewish Lyon while your transfer waits. Private, strictly kosher, 390 € per group, 1 to 5 people. Book on WhatsApp.

## Practical guides: kosher, synagogues, Shabbat, Chabad, mikveh, hotels

- [Chabad houses in Lyon, Villeurbanne and Écully](https://mishpachatours.com/chabad-lyon/): The eight Chabad centres of Lyon and Villeurbanne, with addresses. Shabbat meals and minyan on request.
- [Grande Synagogue of Lyon: How to Visit](https://mishpachatours.com/grande-synagogue-lyon/): The Grande Synagogue of Lyon, built 1864, is closed to visitors outside the Heritage Days. See how to get in, the prayer times and the address.
- [Is Lyon safe for Jewish visitors? Our standard](https://mishpachatours.com/is-lyon-safe-for-jewish-visitors/): How Mishpacha Tours secures its private Jewish tours of Lyon: discreet routes, a guide from the community, security escort on request. The facts.
- [The Jewish cemetery of Lyon (La Mouche)](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-cemetery-lyon/): Address, hours and contact of the Jewish cemetery of La Mouche in Lyon, founded 1795. How to find a family grave.
- [Jewish Lyon in two days, a kosher itinerary](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-lyon-itinerary-2-days/): A two-day Jewish itinerary for Lyon: the Grande Synagogue and rue Juiverie on day one, the CHRD or Montluc on day two, kosher meals and Shabbat planned in.
- [Jewish travel to Lyon: the FAQ](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-travel-lyon-faq/): Nineteen straight answers for a Jewish traveller to Lyon: getting there, kosher, Shabbat, security, prayer and our private tours.
- [Kosher Cervinia: Chef, Shabbat, Minyan, Matterhorn](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-cervinia/): Kosher Cervinia at 2,050 m, under the Matterhorn, with the ski link to Zermatt: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, minyan. One quote.
- [Kosher Cortina: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-cortina/): Kosher Cortina d'Ampezzo in the Dolomites, winter and summer: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan. One request, one quote.
- [Kosher Courmayeur: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-courmayeur/): Kosher Courmayeur, on the Italian side of Mont Blanc: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One quote.
- [Kosher Crans-Montana: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-crans-montana/): Kosher Crans-Montana, Valais, in winter and summer: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One quote.
- [Kosher restaurants in Lyon and Villeurbanne](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-restaurants-lyon/): 31 kosher restaurants, bakeries, butchers, groceries and caterers in Lyon, Villeurbanne and Écully, all on the Beth Din de Lyon list.
- [Kosher catering and Shabbat meals in Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-shabbat-meals-catering-lyon/): Six caterers certified by the Beth Din de Lyon, Chabad Shabbat meals and kosher groceries for a Shabbat in an apartment. How to order before you land.
- [Kosher St. Moritz: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-st-moritz/): Kosher St. Moritz in the Engadine, winter and summer: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays, minyan and Sefer Torah. One quote.
- [Private Van Transfers in France and Abroad](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-van-transfers/): A private van from an airport, station, hotel or ski resort to anywhere in France, and abroad. A licensed driver from our network. Quote on request, never on Shabbat.
- [Kosher Zermatt: Chef, Shabbat and Minyan](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-zermatt/): Kosher Zermatt under the Matterhorn, car-free, in winter and summer: private chef in your chalet, delivered meals, Shabbat, holidays and a minyan. One quote.
- [Mikveh in Lyon and Villeurbanne: Addresses](https://mishpachatours.com/mikveh-lyon/): Eight mikvahs in Lyon and Villeurbanne with addresses and phones. Mikvah Haya Mouchka, 60 rue Crillon, is listed as open nightly. How to ask before you travel.
- [Shabbat in Lyon: Where to Pray, Eat and Sleep](https://mishpachatours.com/shabbat-in-lyon/): Spending Shabbat in Lyon: where to pray, how to eat, where to sleep on foot, what closes on Friday and what to ask before you go.
- [Synagogues in Lyon, prayer times and Shabbat](https://mishpachatours.com/synagogues-lyon/): Eight Chabad houses, the Grande Synagogue de Lyon, Neveh Chalom and 25 minyanim in Lyon and Villeurbanne: addresses, prayer times.
- [Where to Stay in Lyon as a Jewish Traveller](https://mishpachatours.com/where-to-stay-lyon-jewish-travellers/): Three areas to sleep in Lyon when you keep Shabbat: Presqu'île, 6th arrondissement, Villeurbanne. Walking estimates to Tilsitt and the questions to ask a hotel.

## Places and memory: Grande Synagogue, rue Juiverie, CHRD, Montluc, Izieu, history

- [CHRD Lyon: Resistance and Deportation Museum](https://mishpachatours.com/chrd-lyon/): The CHRD in Lyon, in the former Gestapo headquarters: what you see, the Jewish history it tells, hours, prices, tram access and our private guided visit.
- [Jewish history of Lyon, Middle Ages to today](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-history-lyon/): Jewish history of Lyon from the medieval Juiverie to the Resistance, the Barbie trial and today's community, plus the places you can visit in Lyon.
- [Maison d'Izieu: hours, prices, visit from Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/maison-izieu/): The Maison d'Izieu, memorial to the Jewish children arrested on 6 April 1944: history, hours, prices, the guided house visit and the trip from Lyon.
- [Montluc Memorial, Lyon: Visit, Hours, History](https://mishpachatours.com/montluc-prison-lyon/): The Montluc prison memorial in Lyon: free entry, the history of the Jews held there in 1943 and 1944, the Izieu children, access, and the synagogue nearby.
- [Rue Juiverie, Lyon: Medieval Jewish Quarter](https://mishpachatours.com/rue-juiverie-lyon/): Rue Juiverie in Vieux Lyon kept its name from the medieval Jewish community. What remains, what does not, and how to visit with a Jewish guide.

## Alps and region

- [Jewish life around Lyon and in the Alps](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-life-around-lyon/): Synagogues and Chabad houses in Grenoble, Annecy, Aix-les-Bains, Chambéry, Valence and Clermont-Ferrand, winter minyanim in Courchevel and Megève.
